description: FAIRiCUBE deposits a canopy-height mosaic for Barcelona as one public Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF of about 201 MB. The Zenodo description says the mosaic was clipped and filtered, but does not give a reference year, height units, resolution or a method for identifying trees. This is a mapped urban vegetation layer, not an inventory of individual trees. A modeller could combine it with building and street maps in urban-climate simulations to test shade or heat-exposure assumptions around roads, public spaces and other infrastructure. The deposited file is labelled CC BY 4.0 and is free to access. The absence of pixel-unit and validation information means its values should not be treated as measured tree heights without further checks. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this Barcelona mosaic. The raster was not downloaded, so its georeferencing, nodata values and actual cloud-optimized layout were not inspected.
name: Barcelona Canopy Height Model
notes: G6 item G6-2201. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
